# user

```go
import "github.com/aexvir/skladka/internal/user"
```

Package user provides functionality for managing users and authentication.

It handles: \- User registration and authentication using WebAuthn \- User management \(creation, retrieval\)

The package uses go\-webauthn/webauthn for WebAuthn operations and integrates with the storage package for persistence.

Authentication is handled via passkeys, which provides a passwordless authentication mechanism that is both secure and user\-friendly.
